name: Twilio
description: Twilio is a communications platform for messaging, voice, verification, phone numbers, and customer engagement workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated customer-owned Twilio Restricted API key with only GET access to the account Messages collection, then let agents inspect at most ten privacy-masked delivery summaries through one fixed read without exposing message bodies, media, SIDs, account identity, full addresses, prices, errors, sends, administration, writes, pagination, or raw APIs.

credentialRequirements.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
credentialRequirements.label: Twilio Account SID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact AC-prefixed account identifier. Relay validates its shape and binds it into the fixed Messages path.

credentialRequirements.name: TWILIO_API_KEY_SID
credentialRequirements.label: Restricted API Key SID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated SK-prefixed Restricted API key with only GET access to this account's Messages collection.

credentialRequirements.name: TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Restricted API Key secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts this secret and uses it only as the HTTP Basic password for the fixed Twilio read. Delete the key in Twilio Console to revoke provider access.

capabilities.label: List masked message statuses
capabilities.description: Inspect at most ten recent privacy-masked message delivery summaries from one Twilio account.

allowed.label: List recent message statuses
allowed.description: Read at most ten masked Twilio message-status summaries without bodies, media, provider identifiers, prices, or error details.

blocked.label: Block content, identity, and identifiers
blocked.description: Message bodies, media, recordings, transcripts, participants, raw phone numbers, SIDs, account identity, error details, prices, and URIs are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block live communications
blocked.description: SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, voice calls, Verify, Conversations, notifications, bulk work, and all paid or recipient-facing sends are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block administration, writes, and raw access
blocked.description: Phone-number, Messaging Service, Studio, webhook, compliance, IAM, credential, account, subaccount, billing, arbitrary filter, pagination, write, delete, and raw API access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The one fixed masked status read runs automatically; content, identifiers, sends, administration, writes, pagination, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same fixed read runs without Relay per-action approval; exact Restricted-key authority, route, masking, bounds, audits, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one typed masked-status read while Railway alone holds the customer-owned Restricted API key.
Relay mounts one typed masked-status read while Railway alone holds the customer-owned Restricted API key.

providerSetup.blocker: A representative Twilio account, dedicated Restricted API key, exact Messages GET permission validation, current legal/AUP/Messaging/privacy review, staging credential entry, and live validation remain for separate authorized tasks.
providerSetup.nextAction: After batch integration, an authorized Twilio administrator must create a dedicated Restricted API key and validate HTTP Basic auth, the fixed global Messages route, ten-record and 512 KiB bounds, masking and sensitive-field exclusion, no retry or pagination, encrypted-copy deletion, manual provider key deletion, and post-revocation denial.

evidence.supports: Twilio documents Restricted API keys with endpoint-and-method permissions, API Key SID/secret authentication, and Messaging support.
Twilio recommends API keys over Account SID/Auth Token credentials and documents Main, Standard, and Restricted key types plus region-specific credentials.
Twilio documents HTTPS requests authenticated with HTTP Basic auth and recommends API Key SID/secret credentials for production applications.
Twilio documents GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages.json, PageSize bounds, pagination, and sensitive message fields that Relay minimizes or excludes.
Twilio's current terms require compliance with the Acceptable Use Policy, applicable laws, and service-specific rules and permit suspension for fraud or abuse.
Twilio's Acceptable Use Policy and service/country requirements keep any live communications capability outside this read-only V1.
